title_zh: 先了解狗的收养评估并约好见面

scenario.label_zh: 了解收养评估并选择先见面而不带走狗
scenario.goal_zh: 说明对狗的行为及福利的担忧，确认需要评估并约定先在工作人员陪同下见面

context_zh: 虚构动物收容所咨询，访客询问照片中的狗 Moss，不在本次对话中办理收养。
author: author-phase09-c

sentences.speaker: Sana
sentences.text: Is Moss, the dog in your window photo, available for adoption? I felt real affection for him when I saw it.

sentences.speaker: Kit
sentences.text: He's looking for a home, but we arrange a meeting and an assessment before any decision.

sentences.speaker: Sana
sentences.text: His description mentions aggression around food. I don't have experience with that.

sentences.speaker: Kit
sentences.text: Thank you for telling me. His welfare and a suitable match matter more than a quick placement.

sentences.speaker: Sana
sentences.text: Could I meet him with a member of staff rather than take him out on my own?

sentences.speaker: Kit
sentences.text: Yes. We can arrange a supervised meeting here on Saturday at eleven, with no commitment to adopt.

sentences.speaker: Sana
sentences.text: Let's do that. I'll come to learn more, not to take him home that day.
